title: Automatically Neutralizing Subjective Bias in Text

bias_targets.methodology: Translating inappropriately subjective text (including framing and epistemological bias) into a neutral point of view using sequence-to-sequence models, evaluated via exact match accuracy, BLEU score, and crowdsourced human ratings for bias reduction, fluency, and meaning preservation.

Neutralizing language containing presuppositions about gender, race, and other demographic categories within the Wiki Neutrality Corpus, evaluated as a subcategory of the overall automated text neutralization task.

Applying the trained text neutralization models to out-of-domain partisan datasets (the Ideological Books Corpus, biased news headlines, and political campaign speeches) and evaluating the outputs via human ratings.
